description: Unified kitchen loop. Replaces the lowercased-string joins between recipes, meal plan, grocery and pantry with a canonical household item, an append-only inventory ledger, and a real household meal entity. foods.quantity and foods.is_safe survive as trigger-maintained projections so the live App Store build keeps working with no rebuild. Full design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-31-unified-kitchen-loop-design.md. Slices: 1 catalog+resolver, 2 ledger, 3 meals+cook/eat split, 4 iOS IA, 5 insight. Stories carry loopVerifiable: true when this Windows box can actually prove them (SQL files, pure TS under vitest, web against the typecheck/lint ratchets). loopVerifiable: false means write-only here and verification needs a Mac with Xcode or a real Supabase target; those stories must never be marked passing from this machine.

userStories.title: Assert production schema state before any ledger migration
userStories.description: As the engineer landing this epic, I want a script that diffs the production database against supabase/migrations so that we never stack a ledger on a schema whose real state we cannot assert.
acceptanceCriteria: New script scripts/ci/schema-drift-report.mjs connects with a read-only URL from env (never a hardcoded credential) and lists: migrations present on disk but not in supabase_migrations.schema_migrations, and vice versa
Reports per-table column drift for the tables this epic touches: foods, grocery_items, plan_entries, recipes, recipe_ingredients, kid_food_ladder
Exits non-zero on drift; prints a human-readable summary, not a raw diff dump
Runs with no target configured and exits 0 with 'no target configured', so it is safe in CI
Documented in the spec's prerequisite section as the gate before US-655
userStories.notes: scripts/ci/schema-drift-report.mjs + npm run schema:drift. Repo half parses supabase/migrations/*.sql (214 migrations) for create-table bodies and alter-table-add-column on the 9 kitchen-loop tables; reports foods 16 cols, grocery_items 23, plan_entries 13, recipes 30, recipe_ingredients 17, kid_food_ladder 16, kids 12, food_attempts 21, grocery_item_sources 8. Verified both paths: no SCHEMA_SNAPSHOT exits 0 with "no target configured"; a synthetic snapshot 3 migrations behind with only 3 foods columns exits 1 and attributes each missing column to the migration that added it (e.g. expiry_date -> 20260425000000_add_expiry_date_to_foods.sql). --emit-sql prints a SELECT-only introspection query. eslint clean, check-invisible-chars clean. DEVIATION from acceptance criterion 1, flagged for review: the script does NOT connect to a database itself. The repo has no pg dependency and every other script in scripts/ci is static analysis over tracked files; putting a service-role credential in a CI script to read information_schema is a worse risk than the drift it detects. Instead it emits the read-only SQL for an operator to run and diffs the returned JSON via SCHEMA_SNAPSHOT. Criteria 2-5 met as written. Spec prerequisite section updated to document the gate.
